description: This Java class implements a mail container for the Apache OFBiz framework, handling email retrieval via JavaMail API, polling, and processing email messages with rules evaluation.

classes.name: JavaMailContainer
classes.description: Main class implementing email polling and processing for OFBiz framework, managing mail store connections, message retrieval, and rule evaluation.

classes.name: LoggingStoreListener
classes.description: Implements StoreListener to log mail store events.

classes.name: PollerTask
classes.description: Runnable task that polls email stores for new messages, processes unread messages, and handles connection management.

classes.name: MimeMessageWrapper
classes.description: Referenced in processMessage method; wraps MimeMessage for rule evaluation (not fully shown in provided code).

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the mail container with commands, name, and config file.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the mail polling service, loads configuration, establishes mail store sessions, and schedules polling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the polling timer and shuts down the service.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a JavaMail Session from configuration properties.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Establishes and returns a mail Store object, testing connection.

methods.name: updateUrlName
methods.description: Rewrites URLName with credentials and host info from properties.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main polling loop that checks each mail store for new messages.

methods.name: checkMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and processes unread email messages from the inbox.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Wraps and evaluates rules on a MimeMessage.
